This 2011 Volkswagen Jetta SportWagen 2.0L TDI offers a practical combination of efficiency and versatility for the discerning buyer seeking a reliable wagon that delivers genuine performance value.

The heated front seats prove valuable during colder months, while the leather steering wheel and shift knob add tactile refinement to daily operation.

The six-speed automatic transmission with DSG technology manages gear changes smoothly, and the front-wheel-drive layout ensures predictable handling on various road conditions.

Safety systems include dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control works in concert with traction control to maintain composure during challenging driving situations. Four-wheel independent suspension tuning combined with speed-sensing power steering creates a balanced drive feel at both highway and city speeds.

The premium audio system provides multiple connectivity options including SIRIUS satellite radio, CD playback, and MP3 decoder functionality. Ten speakers distribute sound throughout the cabin, while steering wheel controls allow audio management without taking your hands from driving. The radio data system and outside temperature display add practical information to your dashboard view.

This Jetta SportWagen presents itself as a straightforward choice for buyers who value German engineering principles, diesel efficiency, and wagon practicality in a single package. The vehicle's design emphasizes functional comfort and reliable transportation. Contact us today to schedule a thorough test drive and confirm this wagon's fit for your driving routine.

This 2011 Toyota Venza Base combines practical family utility with refined comfort and advanced technology, offering a dependable midsize crossover ready for your everyday adventures.

- JBL Synthesis Surround Sound System with 13 speakers, CD changer, and Bluetooth connectivity
- Panoramic glass roof with power tilt/slide moonroof
- Leather package including 4-way power front passenger seat with lumbar support
- 3.5L V6 engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob with wood-grain trim
- XM satellite radio with three-month subscription
- Front dual-zone automatic temperature control
- USB port with iPod connectivity and MP3/WMA capability
- Dual front and side impact airbags with knee airbag protection
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Power windows, mirrors, and steering wheel
- All-wheel independent suspension
- Remote keyless entry with HomeLink garage door transmitter

The Venza delivers the space and flexibility your family needs with seating for up to five passengers and a spacious interior designed for both comfort and functionality. The split-folding rear seat easily adapts to accommodate passengers or cargo, making this vehicle equally suited for weekend getaways or daily errands. With front and rear reading lights, an overhead console, and multiple storage bins, every occupant has convenient access to essentials.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your driving experience through the comprehensive infotainment system. The JBL audio setup produces clear, balanced sound throughout the cabin, while Bluetooth hands-free capability keeps you connected safely. USB connectivity and iPod integration ensure your music library is always at hand, and XM satellite radio expands your entertainment options beyond traditional broadcasting.

Safety remains paramount in the Venza's design. The vehicle features an extensive airbag system including dual front impact, front side, and overhead airbags along with a knee airbag for comprehensive protection. Electronic Stability Control works in concert with four-wheel disc brakes and anti-lock braking to enhance vehicle control in demanding conditions. Traction control and anti-whiplash front head restraints provide additional security for you and your passengers.

The 3.5L V6 engine delivers capable performance paired with reasonable fuel economy, achieving 19 mpg in the city and 26 mpg on the highway. This balance makes the Venza practical for both urban navigation and longer highway drives without constant refueling stops.

A well-maintained crossover at this price point represents genuine value. Schedule your visit today to experience the Venza's blend of space, comfort, and reliability firsthand.

A one-owner 2017 Subaru Outback 2.5i Limited comes to Adventure Subaru with a clean CARFAX and a service record that reads like a maintenance log kept by someone who genuinely cared for this car. For Northeast Ohio drivers who want capability and comfort in one wagon, especially with lake-effect winters on the way, this Outback brings both.

CARFAX confirms a single owner out of Pennsylvania, with no accidents, no structural damage, and no airbag deployment reported. The service history is extensive and well documented: 25 service records spanning from delivery in early 2017 through this summer, including regular oil and filter changes, front and rear brake pads and rotors replaced in 2021, a new battery and spark plugs in 2021 with spark plugs replaced again in 2025, wheel bearings and hubs replaced in August 2025, and front axle work completed as recently as June 2026, followed by a fresh oil and air filter change in July 2026. Emissions and safety inspections have passed consistently year over year, and CARFAX shows no indication of an odometer rollback and no open recalls. The odometer reads 110,470 miles, and CARFAX notes the prior owner drove under the industry average annually, a sign of steady, well-maintained use rather than hard mileage.

One owner, no accidents, and a documented service history running through this year's front axle service and oil change, that's the kind of transparency that matters most when buying a used Subaru without CPO backing.

Inside, this Outback Limited pairs leather seating with heated front and rear seats, so the whole cabin stays comfortable once temperatures drop along Route 2. The power moonroof, power liftgate, and power driver and passenger seats with memory settings add everyday convenience, while dual-zone climate control and a leather-wrapped steering wheel round out the comfort features. Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive is standard on this Outback, giving it the sure-footed traction Subaru owners count on for Northeast Ohio's winter roads and the back roads around the Cuyahoga Valley. A suite of driver-assist features is on board as well, including Blind Spot Monitor and Cross-Traffic Alert, useful extras for anyone navigating busier Lake County traffic. On the technology side, the Outback comes with a premium sound system and 12 speakers, Bluetooth connectivity, HD Radio, SiriusXM, smart device integration, and a universal garage door opener.

Fuel economy checks in at 25 city / 32 highway MPG.

Whether you complete your purchase online or prefer to come in and see it in person, Adventure Subaru makes the process easy. We're at 1991 Mentor Ave, Painesville, Ohio, serving Lake County and all of Northeast Ohio.

This stylish 2019 Kia Soul Exclaim in black offers the perfect blend of practicality and modern comfort for drivers seeking an adaptable compact crossover. With its spacious interior, responsive handling, and thoughtful amenities, this vehicle delivers the versatility you need for both daily commutes and weekend adventures.

- Panoramic Sunroof with Power Sunshade
- 10-Way Power Adjustable Driver's Seat with Power Lumbar Support
- 8-Way Power Adjustable Passenger Seat
- Harman/Kardon Audio System with 7 Speakers and Subwoofer
- HID Projector Low-Beam Headlights
- LED Fog Lights and LED Positioning Lights
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Heated Front Seats with 2 Adjustable Levels
- Heated Outboard Rear Seat Cushions
- Blind Spot Detection and Rear Cross Traffic Alert
- 8.0" Touchscreen with Navigation, Apple CarPlay, and Android Auto

The Soul Exclaim delivers solid fuel efficiency with an EPA-estimated 26 miles per gallon in the city and 31 on the highway, powered by a fuel-efficient I4 engine paired with a smooth-shifting 7-speed automatic transmission. This front-wheel-drive configuration ensures reliable traction and predictable handling in various driving conditions.

Your comfort is prioritized throughout the cabin. The driver benefits from a 10-way power seat with lumbar support, while passengers enjoy an 8-way adjustable seat. Both front seats feature two levels of heating to keep you warm during cooler months, and the heated steering wheel adds an extra layer of comfort on chilly drives. Rear passengers aren't forgotten, with heated outboard seat cushions available.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily drive through the Technology Package, which includes an 8.0-inch touchscreen displaying premium navigation powered by UVO eServices. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility keeps your smartphone's key functions at your fingertips, while the Harman/Kardon audio system with seven speakers and a subwoofer makes every journey enjoyable. Two USB chargers in the center console keep devices powered throughout your travels.

Safety features work quietly in the background to protect you and your passengers. Blind Spot Detection alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, while Rear Cross Traffic Alert assists when reversing. The vehicle includes dual front and side airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and a low tire pressure warning system. The exterior parking camera provides clear visibility when backing up.

The Soul Exclaim stands ready to enhance your driving experience with its combination of practical features, modern technology, and thoughtful design. We invite you to visit our showroom to explore this vehicle in person and take it for a test drive.

The Soul LX is equipped with a 2.0L I4 DOHC engine paired with a CVT transmission and front-wheel drive, delivering 29 city and 35 highway miles per gallon. This efficient powertrain strikes a balance between responsive performance and practical fuel economy, making it well-suited for both city commutes and longer drives.

What sets this particular Soul apart is its Technology Package, which brings advanced safety features to enhance your confidence on the road. Blind Spot Collision Warning alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, while Forward Collision Avoidance Assist helps prevent accidents by detecting obstacles ahead. Lane Keeping Assist and Lane Change Assist work together to help you stay centered in your lane, and Rear Cross-Traffic Collision Avoidance Assist provides visibility when backing up. Driver Attention Warning monitors your alertness behind the wheel, complementing the 360-degree awareness these systems create.

Interior features include a comfortable front bucket seat configuration with woven and tricot cloth trim, split folding rear seats for flexible cargo space, and a front center armrest for added comfort. You'll appreciate the steering wheel-mounted audio controls, which keep your hands on the wheel while managing the AM/FM/MP3 audio system and compatible smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.

Safety is addressed through a comprehensive suite of features including dual front and side impact airbags, overhead airbags, 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist. Practical touches like the exterior parking camera rear, delay-off headlights, low tire pressure warning, and rear window defroster make daily driving easier.

Black exterior paint and carpeted floor mats complete the package, while 16-inch alloy wheels give the Soul a polished appearance. With 74,093 miles on the odometer, this Soul has been maintained and is ready for years of dependable service.

- Voice-activated GPS navigation system with 6.1" LCD touch screen

This Impreza combines practicality with everyday comfort. The all-wheel drive system provides confident handling in varied weather conditions, while the 2.0L engine delivers an efficient balance of power and fuel economy, achieving 27 mpg in the city and 36 mpg on the highway. The CVT transmission operates smoothly, adapting to your driving style for responsive acceleration when needed.

The interior reflects the Sport Limited trim's attention to detail. Heated front seats wrapped in leather keep you comfortable during cold months, while the leather steering wheel and shift knob add a premium feel. The automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin climate effortlessly, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.

Technology integration ensures connectivity throughout your journey. The voice-activated navigation system guides you reliably with its 6.1" touch screen display, while Bluetooth connectivity allows hands-free calling and audio streaming from compatible devices. The audio system includes HD Radio, a CD player, SIRIUS XM satellite radio capability, and multiple input options—USB, auxiliary jack, and iPod control—so your music travels with you however you prefer.

Safety and visibility receive strong attention. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and four-wheel disc ABS brakes work together to maintain security on the road. Dual front airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags provide comprehensive occupant protection. Front fog lights combine with fully automatic headlights to enhance visibility during challenging driving conditions.

With 71,676 miles on the odometer, this Impreza remains ready for years of dependable service. The black exterior with aero splash guards presents a clean, purposeful appearance, while the roof rack rails offer practical versatility for your lifestyle needs.

OVERVIEW
The 2019 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is the ultimate expression of American Muscle and the most powerful production Corvette ever built with a front-mounted engine. Developed as the final evolution of the C7 platform, the ZR1 pushes performance to extraordinary levels, combining supercharged V8 power, advanced aerodynamics, and track-ready engineering into a machine capable of competing with the world's best supercars. Power comes from a hand-assembled 6.2-liter supercharged LT5 V8, producing a whopping 755 horsepower and 715 lb-ft of torque. Paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission, the ZR1 rockets from 0-60 mph in just 2.8 seconds and reaches a top speed of over 210 mph. The massive 2.65-liter Eaton supercharger delivers relentless acceleration throughout the rev range, while the quad exhaust produces an unmistakable soundtrack that is equal parts thunder and fury. The chassis was engineered to handle every bit of the ZR1's immense output. Magnetic Ride Control continuously adapts to changing road conditions, while an electronic limited-slip differential and wide performance tires provide remarkable grip. Visually, the ZR1 looks every bit as intimidating as its performance suggests. A massive carbon-fiber hood accommodates the oversized supercharger while improving cooling, and the aggressive front fascia channels air through multiple heat exchangers. Wide fenders, an enormous rear wing, and a sculpted rear diffuser help give the ZR1 an unmistakable presence. Inside, the cabin balances performance with modern comfort. Leather-trimmed sport seats, carbon-fiber accents, a flat-bottom steering wheel, and a digital instrument cluster create a cockpit focused on the driver. Modern creature comforts come in the form of climate controlled seats, a head-up display, and Bose premium audio. The 2019 Chevrolet Corvette ZR1 is a car that combines supercharged V8 power, world-class handling, and race-inspired aerodynamics into a package that challenges exotic supercars costing two and three times as much. This 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 RS represents a pinnacle of engineering and performance, combining track-proven dynamics with carefully appointed luxury details. With 27,256 miles and finished in striking GT Silver Metallic, this vehicle delivers the precision and capability that defines the GT3 RS lineage.

- Porsche Ceramic Composite Brakes (PCCB) with 410mm front and 390mm rear discs
- Front Axle Lift System
- Weissach Package with front lid in exterior color
- Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus (PDLS Plus) with LED headlights in black
- BOSE Surround Sound System with 555 watts and 12 loudspeakers
- 4.0L H6 engine producing 520 horsepower
- 7-Speed Porsche Doppelkupplung (PDK) transmission
- Black leather and Alcantara seat trim with extended leather interior package
- Light Design Package with ambient LED lighting throughout
- Sport Chrono Package
- Carbon fiber sportdesign exterior mirrors and window triangle trims
- Satin platinum painted wheels with RS logo centers
- Automatically dimming interior and exterior mirrors with rain sensor
- Navigation system with Porsche Communication Management
- Rear parking camera

The GT3 RS commands respect on any road. The 4.0L horizontally opposed six-cylinder engine delivers 520 horsepower through a 7-speed PDK transmission optimized for both precision and engagement. The front axle lift system provides practical relief during daily driving, while the PCCB ceramic brakes offer fade-resistant stopping power with signature yellow calipers. Achieving 15 mpg city and 19 mpg highway, this driver rewards commitment with responsiveness at every throttle input.

Inside, meticulous attention elevates the driving experience. The black leather and Alcantara seat trim combines durability with refinement, while extended leather appointments throughout the cabin create an environment built for focus. The Light Design Package incorporates ambient LED lighting in the overhead console, door handles, storage compartments, and footwells, establishing an atmosphere as purposeful as the machine itself. The BOSE surround sound system delivers 555 watts across 12 speakers, ensuring clarity whether cruising or engaging.

The Weissach Package distinguishes this example with a front lid finished in the vehicle's exterior color, marking it as a distinctly equipped model. Carbon fiber accents frame the side windows and sportdesign mirrors, while illuminated carbon fiber door-sill guards with model logos enhance the cockpit entry. The Porsche Dynamic Light System Plus maintains visibility with LED headlights in black, complemented by the Sport Chrono clock dial in white.

Satin platinum painted 20-inch front and 21-inch rear wheels wrapped in performance rubber convey the GT3 RS's capabilities. Rain-sensing wipers and automatic dimming mirrors respond to conditions with intelligence, while the rear parking camera and multiple airbags support confident ownership. A comprehensive navigation system integrates with Porsche Communication Management for seamless operation.

This 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 RS awaits a driver ready to command its precision. We invite you to experience this machine firsthand and understand why every detail serves the purpose of exceptional performance and engagement.

Offered here is an exceptionally rare and historically significant 2019 Lamborghini Aventador S, a one-of-one creation developed in collaboration between Automobili Lamborghini and internationally acclaimed American artist Skyler Grey. Unveiled during Monterey Car Week 2019, this extraordinary Aventador S represents the intersection of contemporary art and automotive excellence, making it one of the most unique Lamborghinis ever produced.


Known as the Fresh Prince of Street Art, Skyler Grey earned worldwide recognition at a young age and was named to Forbes' prestigious 30 Under 30 list of influential artists. Lamborghini selected Grey to transform an Aventador S into a rolling work of art, providing the vehicle as a blank canvas finished in stunning Pearl Effect Arancio Atlas paint. The project was completed within Lamborghini's newly opened in-house paint facility, showcasing the limitless possibilities of the Ad Personam customization program while celebrating the fusion of artistic expression and automotive design.


Over the course of three weeks, Grey worked alongside an interdepartmental Lamborghini team to create what became the first street-legal work of art on four wheels. Utilizing the defining techniques of modern street artincluding airbrushes, spray guns, rollers, and stencilsthe exterior was transformed into a vibrant composition of orange and yellow graphics featuring stylized charging bulls racing across the bodywork. The artwork incorporates imagery inspired by pop art icon Andy Warhol's famous Campbell's Soup Can series, creating a visual dialogue between contemporary street art and classic pop culture.


The interior is equally distinctive, featuring Nero Ade leather upholstery with contrasting orange stitching, Ad Personam leather appointments, extensive interior carbon fiber trim, and a unique embroidered cartoon bull motif crafted by Lamborghini's skilled upholstery specialists. Every detail was carefully executed to complement the exterior artwork while maintaining the unmistakable character of the Aventador S.


Beyond its artistic significance, this Aventador S holds a unique place in Lamborghini history as the first Lamborghini certified through blockchain technology. As part of the Lamborghini Sicura pilot program developed in partnership with Salesforce, the vehicle received an advanced authenticity certification system designed to protect the car as a work of art while ensuring secure provenance tracking and long-term collectability.


The vehicle was prominently displayed at The Lamborghini Lounge Monterey during Monterey Car Week, overlooking the famed 18th hole of Pebble Beach Golf Links. Presented within an environment inspired by the theme Created to Inspire, the Aventador S by Skyler Grey stood as a centerpiece celebrating innovation, creativity, and the future of automotive personalization.


This highly optioned example was specified with Pearl Effect Arancio Atlas paint, Nero Ade interior, black brake calipers, the Travel Package, interior details in high gloss black, Lamborghini logo branding package, S-Trim with full leather interior, forged Dianthus wheels measuring 20 inches in front and 21 inches in the rear, a transparent engine bonnet, contrast stitching, fully electric and heated seats, extensive interior carbon fiber trim, and Ad Personam leather appointments.


Further enhancing its exclusivity, this Aventador S is accompanied by official Lamborghini Polo Storico documentation confirming its creation in direct collaboration between Automobili Lamborghini and Skyler Grey. The documentation verifies the vehicle's one-of-one status and authenticates its significance as the only example produced as part of this groundbreaking artistic project.

description:
This 2024 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray 2LT represents a pinnacle of American sports car engineering, delivering authentic performance and refined luxury in a package built for those who demand excellence.

- GT2 Bucket Seats with heated and ventilated surfaces
- Z51 Performance Package including upgraded suspension, brakes, and performance exhaust
- Z51 Performance Rear Axle Ratio with Electronic Limited-Slip Differential
- Front Lift Adjustable Height with Memory and automatic headlamp leveling
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System with Navigation
- Bose Performance Series Sound System with 14 speakers and SiriusXM
- Carbon Fiber Interior Trim on cluster surround and console door switch plates
- Head-Up Display with performance data and video recorder capability
- Heated and power-adjustable door mirrors with auto-dimming capability
- 19" x 8.5" front and 20" x 11" rear bright silver alloy wheels with high-performance tires
- Heavy-Duty Cooling System for sustained performance
- Heated steering wheel with leather wrapping and memory function
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert with exterior parking camera
- Wireless charging for devices and universal home remote

The 6.2L V8 engine paired with an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission puts genuine performance at your command. This Corvette achieves 16 city and 25 highway MPG, balancing power with practical efficiency. The Z51 Performance Package elevates every aspect of the driving experience with performance-tuned suspension, advanced braking capability, and a distinctive rear spoiler with front splitter that communicates serious intent.

Inside, the cabin reflects meticulous craftsmanship with GT2 bucket seats offering both comfort and support for spirited driving. Heated and ventilated seating surfaces adapt to any climate, while carbon fiber trim accents throughout reinforce the premium character. Memory settings for the driver's seat and steering wheel ensure your preferences are always ready, and an 8-way power adjustment system lets you find your ideal driving position effortlessly.

Technology integration is comprehensive and intuitive. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium System features navigation, while the Bose audio system delivers concert-quality sound through 14 strategically placed speakers. The Head-Up Display projects critical driving information onto the windshield, and the integrated performance data and video recorder lets you capture and analyze your driving experiences.

Safety and convenience features are woven throughout. Rear Cross Traffic Alert assists when backing, while the exterior parking camera provides visual confirmation. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
    • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.

Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
    • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.

With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. The 2025 Ford Mustang GT Premium immediately stands out for drivers who crave tangible connection to the road. From the moment you settle into the Black Onyx interior and grip the leather steering wheel, this sports coupe delivers a sense of anticipation.

Enthusiasts who demand more than point-A-to-B transportation will find this coupe a natural fit. Those who notice the subtle weight of a steering rack, the way a car settles into a corner, or the satisfaction of a well-timed downshift will appreciate the GT Premium’s calibration. In commutes around Lakeland, FL or spirited weekend drives, the Mustang’s blend of responsive controls and real tactile engagement transforms daily driving into an event. The dual-zone automatic climate control, B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen, and intuitive FordPass Connect ensure the experience is as refined as it is rewarding, making it ideal for drivers who test-drive for feel and excitement, not just features.

Performance is where the GT Premium shines brightest. The 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine responds crisply to throttle input, and the automatic transmission delivers quick, decisive shifts—whether accelerating hard or cruising smoothly. Rear-wheel drive enhances the coupe’s classic dynamics, allowing the chassis to pivot confidently through curves while maintaining balance and composure. Speed-sensing steering provides natural weight and meaningful feedback, letting you feel the road’s texture without harshness. The four-wheel independent suspension and sport steering wheel work together to create a planted, agile sensation, making every drive memorable and immersive.

Safety technology in this Mustang supports spirited driving rather than diluting it. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control intervene seamlessly, stepping in only when truly needed to keep the car tracking true without restricting the driver’s sense of control. The Ford Co-Pilot360 Assist+ suite augments confidence in daily use, with features like rear parking sensors and a rearview camera supporting precise maneuvering. Emergency communication via 911 Assist and rain-sensing wipers contribute to focus and safety, while the Mustang’s suite of airbags and brake assist ensure security without interfering with the coupe’s engaging character.

This GT Premium’s Equipment Group 400A Standard Package brings together driver-focused amenities and advanced tech for an immersive experience. The B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with 12 speakers fills the cabin with crisp audio, while the connected navigation system guides you on every adventure. The leather shift knob and steering wheel add tactile pleasure, and the sport steering wheel underscores the performance focus.

Comparing the Mustang GT Premium to rivals like the Chevrolet Camaro SS and Dodge Challenger R/T highlights its unique character. Where the Camaro emphasizes cornering grip and the Challenger focuses on straight-line might, this coupe strikes a harmonious balance between agility and everyday usability.

Is this coupe engaging to drive? Absolutely—the steering, throttle, and suspension work in concert to deliver immediate response and real feedback. What is the steering feel like? Speed-sensing calibration ensures the wheel feels substantial, with meaningful communication from the road surface.

To experience the Mustang GT Premium’s blend of power and engagement firsthand, visit Lakeland Automall at 1430 W Memorial Blvd, Lakeland, FL 33815, or call (863) 577-5030. Schedule a test drive and discover how rewarding everyday driving can truly be.

- 5.0L V8 Ti-VCT engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 18" x 8.5" ebony black painted aluminum wheels
- Exterior parking camera with rear parking sensors
- SYNC 4 infotainment system with internet access capable FordPass Connect
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone A/C
- Leather steering wheel and leather shift knob

- Auto high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality
- Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars
- Electronic stability control and traction control
- Dual front impact and side impact airbags

The 18-inch ebony black painted aluminum wheels are wrapped in performance rubber that connects you directly to the road. Every detail, from the perfectly positioned hood to the sculpted rear quarter panels, speaks to the engineering that went into this machine.

Front bucket seats with a center armrest provide the support you need during spirited driving, while the split folding rear seat offers flexibility for occasional passengers or additional cargo space. The leather shift knob adds a premium touch to every gear change, and the automatic temperature control keeps the cabin at your preferred setting regardless of conditions.

The Mustang GT's connectivity features keep you informed and in touch. SYNC 4 infotainment brings smartphone integration and internet access capability through FordPass Connect. The 6-speaker AM/FM stereo with radio data system delivers clear, engaging sound, while steering wheel mounted audio controls let you manage your music without taking your hands off the wheel. An overhead console organizes essentials, and illuminated entry lighting ensures you're always aware of your surroundings.

Safety and control come standard with comprehensive systems designed to keep you confident behind the wheel. Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars creates a responsive driving platform. Electronic stability control and traction control work in concert to maintain grip and stability. Multiple airbags, including front impact, side impact, knee, and overhead airbags, provide layered protection. Anti-lock braking with dual front and rear disc brakes gives you the stopping power to match the acceleration.

This is genuine performance designed for drivers who appreciate uncompromising capability and authentic American muscle. We invite you to experience the 2025 Mustang GT in person and schedule a test drive today.

  • Cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful, until cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed using the steering wheel mounted controls and it will maintain that speed without driver intervention. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Resting your right foot is right at your fingertips thanks to cruise control with steering wheel mounted controls.
  • Smart device engine start control - Phone ahead. Remotely start your vehicle's engine from your smart device, ensuring your ride is ready to go when you get in. Now you can stay comfortable inside while your vehicle gets comfortable outside, thanks to Smart device engine start control.
Safety and Security
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Rear collision mitigation - It has your back. Rear collision mitigation uses sensors to monitor the area behind you. If it senses an impending crash, it activates certain features to help prevent a collision or reduce the severity of it. Put your worries behind you with rear collision mitigation.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics

The 2025 Nissan Z Performance continues to prove why the Z nameplate has remained one of the most beloved sports cars in America for over five decades, pairing genuine heritage-inspired styling with a genuinely thrilling twin-turbo V6. This Z was built for drivers who want an engaging, driver-focused sports car without stepping into six-figure territory. Equipped with a limited-slip differential and Nissan Performance brakes with red calipers, this Z Performance trim adds meaningful traction and stopping confidence over the base Sport model, giving it a genuinely sharper, more track-capable character. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The Z has carried forward a legacy of accessible, genuinely engaging sports car ownership stretching back to the original 1969 Datsun 240Z, and the current generation continues that tradition with a twin-turbo V6 that delivers real performance without unnecessary complexity. Shoppers drawn to the Z want quick acceleration, sharp handling, and a genuine connection to the driving experience that few modern sports cars still offer at this price point. Beyond straight-line speed, the Z has built a reputation for quick, well-weighted steering and minimal body roll, with reviewers consistently praising its blend of everyday livability and genuine weekend-warrior capability. It remains a favorite among enthusiasts who want a true sports car they can drive every day. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Reviewers have consistently praised the Z's 400-horsepower twin-turbo V6 for its sharp throttle response and minimal turbo lag, with Car and Driver noting the engine has their undivided attention and calling the Z a more refined and livable daily driver than its predecessor. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 6,437-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage New Vehicle Limited Warranty Covers most non-wear components for bumper-to-bumper peace of mind. Expiration: 08/16/2028 or 36,000 miles, whichever comes first. Powertrain Limited Warranty Covers the engine, transmission, and drivetrain against defects. Expiration: 08/16/2030 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. Corrosion (Perforation) Warranty Covers rust-through of exterior body panels. Expiration: 08/16/2030. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind throughout your ownership experience. STANDARD FEATURES The Performance trim adds meaningful upgrades over the base Sport model, including 19-inch RAYS forged alloy wheels, a limited-slip differential, and Nissan Performance brakes with red-painted calipers. Leather-appointed seats with heating and knee bolsters, along with front and rear spoilers, round out a trim that feels genuinely track-ready without sacrificing everyday comfort. INSTALLED OPTIONS Illuminated Kick Plates with Interior Door Scuff Protection MECHANICAL FEATURES Power comes from a 3.0-liter twin-turbocharged V6, producing 400 horsepower and 350 lb-ft of torque -- an engine that pulls hard all the way to its 6,800-rpm redline with sharp throttle response and essentially zero turbo lag from the midrange on up. The 9-speed automatic transmission delivers quick, confident shifts, with Car and Driver clocking the automatic Z at 0-60 mph in just 4.3 seconds. The Performance trim's limited-slip differential helps put that power down more effectively through corners, while rear-wheel drive and quick, well-weighted steering give this Z the kind of genuine driver engagement that defines the nameplate. EXTERIOR FEATURES The Z's long hood and short rear deck pay direct homage to the original 240Z, giving it an unmistakable silhouette among modern sports cars. The Performance trim's 19-inch RAYS forged wheels and front and rear spoilers sharpen that heritage-inspired design with a genuinely track-focused edge. LED headlights and a sweeping LED taillight bar give the Z a modern lighting signature that still nods to its Z-car heritage, rounding out an exterior that turns heads without trying too hard. INTERIOR FEATURES Inside, the Z wraps the driver in a cockpit designed with performance in mind, with a horizontal instrument panel and leather-appointed seats featuring knee bolsters and heating for genuine everyday comfort. Body-color bumpers, heated power door mirrors, and an aerodynamic spoiler contribute to its purposeful appearance. - Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility

The manual gearbox puts you in complete control of every acceleration and downshift.

Inside, modern technology meets classic Mustang spirit. The SYNC 3 system features a responsive 8 touchscreen with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected without distraction. The 9-speaker stereo system delivers rich sound for your favorite music, while the 3-month SiriusXM subscription offers unlimited entertainment options. Dual-zone temperature control ensures driver and passenger comfort on every drive.

The driving experience benefits from selectable drive modes accessible via convenient toggle switches, allowing you to tailor the Mustang's characteristics to your preferences. Four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control work together to deliver responsive handling. Power steering, power windows, and remote keyless entry add everyday convenience to this performance machine.

This 2021 Mustang GT has been thoroughly inspected and is Ford Gold Certified, backed by comprehensive coverage and support designed to give you confidence in your purchase.

- 172-point inspection completed
- Roadside assistance included
- Vehicle history report provided
- Transferable warranty protection
- Limited warranty: 12 months/12,000 miles after factory warranty expires
- Powertrain limited warranty: 84 months/100,000 miles from original in-service date
- $100 warranty deductible
- 22,000 FordPass Rewards Points toward first two maintenance visits

With 49,269 miles on the odometer, this Mustang still has plenty of road ahead. The Blue exterior with its aggressive lines and body-color bumpers commands attention, while the rear spoiler emphasizes the performance heritage. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror, illuminated entry, and exterior parking camera add practical refinement to the iconic design.

Ownership of a Mustang GT means joining a legacy of American performance. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand and discover why the Mustang continues to captivate drivers who demand authentic performance combined with modern convenience.

This 2021 Chevrolet Camaro SS 2SS combines striking performance with refined comfort, offering an engaging driving experience backed by comprehensive features and thoughtful design.

- 6.2L V8 Engine with 10-Speed Automatic Transmission
- Bose Premium 9-Speaker Audio System with SiriusXM 360L
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto

The black exterior creates a commanding presence, while the 20-inch aluminum wheels enhance the vehicle's athletic stance.

Inside, the cabin prioritizes comfort and convenience. The 8-way power driver seat with memory function allows you to find your ideal position, while heated and ventilated front seats adapt to seasonal conditions. The heated steering wheel adds another layer of comfort during colder months. Premium leather-trimmed seating throughout the cabin reflects the SS 2SS trim's upscale positioning.

Entertainment and connectivity are seamlessly integrated through the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus System, which features Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility. The Bose Premium 9-Speaker Audio System delivers quality sound, complemented by SiriusXM 360L satellite radio access. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep your attention on the road.

Safety systems throughout this vehicle provide confidence during every drive. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with speed-sensing steering creates responsive handling, while electronic stability control and traction control work to maintain composure in challenging conditions. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power. A comprehensive airbag system and low tire pressure warning keep you and your passengers protected.

The vehicle runs at an estimated 16 MPG city and 26 MPG highway, providing reasonable efficiency for a performance machine of this caliber. With just over 49,000 miles, this Camaro offers plenty of remaining service life and manufacturer warranty potential to explore.

We invite you to experience this 2021 Chevrolet Camaro SS 2SS in person and take it for a test drive to appreciate its capabilities firsthand.

This 2021 INFINITI Q60 Red Sport 400 represents a sophisticated choice for drivers who demand both performance and refined comfort in their daily drive.

- Premium Paint
- Carbon Fiber Package with fog lamp finisher, fender vents, rear spoiler, and mirror covers
- INFINITI InTouch Navigation with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- ProACTIVE Package including Active Lane Control, Direct Adaptive Steering, and Lane Departure Prevention
- Adaptive Front Lighting System with auto high-beam headlights
- 3.0L V6 engine with 7-Speed Automatic transmission and AWD
- Heated front bucket seats with power adjustment and memory functions
- Semi-Aniline leather-appointed seating surfaces
- Blind-Spot Intervention and Blind Spot Warning
- 20" aluminum-alloy sport wheels
- Power moonroof
- Adaptive suspension with four-wheel independent setup
- INFINITI Connection emergency communication system
- Dual-zone automatic temperature control
- 13-speaker premium audio system with SiriusXM

The Red Sport 400 delivers a commanding presence on the road with its white exterior and purposeful styling accented by genuine carbon fiber elements throughout. The aerodynamic carbon fiber package elevates the vehicle's visual appeal while the premium paint finish ensures this Q60 maintains its striking appearance.

Inside, you'll find a carefully curated environment built for both comfort and control. The heated front bucket seats with memory settings adjust to your preferences, and the semi-aniline leather surfaces provide a refined tactile experience. The heated steering wheel and dual-zone climate control work together to create the ideal cabin environment regardless of season. The telescoping tilt steering wheel adjusts to your exact driving position.

This Q60 is equipped with a robust collection of safety and convenience technologies designed to enhance your confidence behind the wheel. The ProACTIVE Package integrates Active Lane Control, Direct Adaptive Steering, and Lane Departure Prevention to assist you during your commute. Blind-Spot Intervention works alongside traditional blind spot warning to help prevent unintended lane changes. The Adaptive Front Lighting System intelligently adjusts your headlights for optimal visibility in various driving conditions.

Your connection to technology remains seamless with the INFINITI InTouch Navigation system, which integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility for convenient smartphone integration. The 13-speaker premium audio system delivers quality sound whether you're enjoying SiriusXM satellite radio, streaming through your phone, or playing CDs. The garage door transmitter brings additional convenience to your daily routine.

The technical foundation supporting this Q60 combines a 3.0L V6 engine with 7-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive to balance responsive performance with practical efficiency. The adaptive suspension with four-wheel independent setup absorbs road texture while maintaining body control. Speed-sensing steering and direct adaptive steering technology provide appropriate feedback and handling characteristics across different driving scenarios.
